training.final_rule: May increase after OWN_WGS_GREEN using genotype-only effective genomic dimension / LD / callability and frozen model-complexity budget only.

simulation.decision_rule: same one-sided sign-flip rule as frozen Fig3 scorer
simulation.end_to_end_simulation_after_pilot: allowed only with genotype-only pilot quantities and frozen F/M/R pipeline

decisions.POWER_READY: Primary validation power requirement and TRAIN adequacy are feasible after QC inflation.
decisions.POWER_LIMITED: Feasible design adequately powers only larger predictive separation than the primary delta=0.40 target.
decisions.POWER_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: Genotype-only pilot quantities needed for design are unavailable.
decisions.POWER_INFEASIBLE: Primary frozen power requirement cannot be met within feasible sampling ceiling.

claim_boundary: Power class is a design property and is not evidence for F, M or R.
